title: Resend hero
description: A black, window-tall hero: a pill badge whose thin rainbow rim slowly turns, a huge two-line display-serif title lit white to half-white, a grey lead and a graphite button beside a text link, with a 3D-object slot to the right and a faint light wash from the top corner. Phones stack the object on top and centre everything, buttons full width.
notes: fills the window height from lg up (min-h-svh); content-sized on phones like the original
object and backdrop are media slots (a WebGL scene and a light-streak image in the original): placeholders until filled
the title reads --resend-serif from the resend theme, falling back to the display face elsewhere
name: resend-hero
